_comment: Schema reference for the Cloud Function-only 'driver_otps' collection. The document ID is the normalized E.164 driver phone number. This is not a live Firestore document.
_security: Never store the plaintext OTP or OTP_PEPPER in this collection. OTP_PEPPER is a Secret Manager secret.

challengeId.description: Random identifier replaced with every permitted send or resend.

attempts.description: Verification attempts against the current challenge; reset only when the challenge is replaced.

consumedAt.description: Set once after the unchanged challenge is successfully verified.

verifiedUid.description: Firebase Auth UID associated after challenge consumption. It is cleared whenever a permitted resend replaces the challenge. An Auth/token failure leaves the challenge consumed; recovery requires a new OTP without resetting abuse counters.

lastSentAt.description: Last permitted send time, used for the resend cooldown.

sendWindowStartedAt.description: Start of the active abuse-accounting window.

sendCount.description: Permitted sends in the active window. Replacing a challenge does not erase this counter.

blockedUntil.description: Send block expiry. The next permitted send after expiry starts a fresh window and counter.
